title.ja: 無軟化Kepler二体の時間誤差

summary.ja: 非等質量二体をKDKで1周し、独立Kepler方程式の位置・速度とエネルギー/角運動量を照合。
summary.en: Advance an unequal-mass binary for one orbit with KDK and compare independent Kepler positions/velocities and conservation.

algorithm.ja: 位置のみの力でkick半分→drift→kick半分。独立のbracketed Kepler rootと解析速度を使用。
algorithm.en: Position-only kick-half/drift/kick-half; separate bracketed Kepler root and analytic velocities.

validation.ja: 位相/時間次数、全同期stepエネルギー、P/L/COM、独立pair力とroot残差。
validation.en: Time refinement/phase, synchronized all-step energy,P/L/COM,independent pair force and root residuals.

limits.ja: 1周期・固定離心率のみ。軟化軌道や長時間安定性はこの参照の範囲外。
limits.en: One orbit at fixed eccentricity only; softened binaries and long-time behavior are outside this exact reference.

references.title: JPL Keplerian-element formulas
references.review_scope: Kepler equation and orbital-plane Cartesian conversion inspected only. No planetary fitting coefficients or approximate planetary ephemeris used. Fixed two-body positions/velocities are independently derived.

references.title: Geometric numerical integration illustrated by the Störmer–Verlet method
references.review_scope: Author/publisher metadata only; author PDF unavailable. KDK composition and reversibility are independently derived here; no original full-text audit or BH symplecticity claim.

caption.ja: 固定入力を実際に計算した保存配列からの検証図。
caption.en: Validation figure from actual saved fixed-input calculation arrays.

title.ja: 冷たいPlummer密度由来32粒子の短時間力学
title.en: Short-time32body dynamics from a cold Plummer-density sample

summary.ja: 同じ軟化有限N ODEで時間誤差と木近似誤差を分け、独立DOP853・直接力と収支を比較。
summary.en: Separate time and tree-force errors for the same softened finite-N ODE with independent DOP853/direct-force references and budgets.

assumptions.ja: 固定32等質量・切断r3の密度由来反対称座標、初速0、epsilon.05、T.2。密度尺度a1とは別。
assumptions.en: Fixed32equal masses,antipodal truncatedr3 density-derived positions,zero velocity,epsilon.05,T.2; density scalea1 differs from pair softening.

algorithm.ja: 直接KDK20/40/80steps、最細でtheta0/.35/.6のfull second-moment BH。独立scalar対力+DOP853を2許容値で資格確認。
algorithm.en: Direct KDK20/40/80steps; finest-dt full second-moment BHtheta0/.35/.6; qualify independent scalar-pair DOP853 at two tolerances.

validation.ja: 非零の固定尺度、同一座標上の力、同期E/P/L/COM、theta0対照、非対称静的probe。
validation.en: Nonzero fixed scales,same-position force comparison,synchronizedE/P/L/COM,theta0 control and asymmetric static probe.

limits.ja: 冷たい有限N初期値で平衡Plummer分布/連続球厳密軌道ではありません。BHの一般相反性・大域symplectic性は主張しません。
limits.en: Cold finite-N initial value,not an equilibrium Plummer DF or exact continuum orbit. No general BH reciprocity/global symplecticity claim.

references.title: On the Problem of Distribution in Globular Star Clusters
references.review_scope: Bibliography inherited from prior scoped source review; original full text not read. The finite32-body cold initial condition is density-derived, not an equilibrium Plummer DF or exact continuum flow.

references.title: galpy official Plummer potential definition
references.review_scope: Official potential normalization read in preparatory source review. No galpy execution; density scale1 and pair softening.05 are distinct parameters.

references.title: SciPy1.14.1 solve_ivp
references.review_scope: DOP853 order8, tolerance and t_eval semantics inspected; same softened finite-N ODE with independent scalar pair force. Not an exact analytic N-body solution.

references.title: Geometric numerical integration illustrated by the Störmer–Verlet method
references.review_scope: Author/publisher metadata only; author PDF unavailable. KDK composition and reversibility are independently derived here; no original full-text audit or BH symplecticity claim.
